invariants.rationale: A successful return from execute() should return a non-null HoodieWriteMetadata object unless there was an exception.
The getWriteStatuses() method should not return null to properly represent the status of the bulk insert.
A successful bulk insert typically yields one or more WriteStatus objects in the return metadata.
The method is expected to return HoodieWriteMetadata parameterized by List<WriteStatus>.
Each WriteStatus in the result list should be non-null to maintain metadata integrity.
